Cross Country Bbq Sauce
By: Gabriel Cross
Published: Saturday, May 8, 2010 - 7:12pm

Ingredients




1/4 cup Molasses
1 tablespoon Soy Sauce
1 tablespoon Honey
2 tablespoons Balsamic Vinegar
1 tablespoon Sriracha

Preparation

1 Combine all ingredients and stir until well mixed 2 Taste, and adjust proportions as needed.

About


This BBQ sauce is inspired by different traditions of American BBQ from the East Coast to Hawaii.  It is quick, simple, and absolutely delicious.  It goes with any grilled meat, or as a sauce for a burger.
